cells.quote: The designs in the sample encompass two reviews – one scoping [37] and one narrative [4] – and 16 empirical studies – six explorative studies [8, 11, 12, 33, 34, 36] as well as 11 evaluation studies [6, 7, 14, 23, 27, 32, 34]. Ten single case studies dominate the sample.
cells.note: This is a methodological mapping-review finding rather than a treatment-versus-comparison effect. University students are the P2P-teachers, so age is coded adult; prior expertise is not stated.

O.outcome_detail: identified medical and student P2P-teaching competencies

cells.quote: The analysis brings three medical and 12 student P2P-teaching competencies to the fore. Together these competencies form a competency-profile for student P2P-teachers.
cells.note: The mapping review identifies and synthesizes competency contents rather than testing a treatment against a comparison; no comparative effect is reported.

D.treatment: studies using learning or teaching theory
D.comparison: studies with weak or limited theoretical grounding

cells.quote: The empirical studies mainly report empirical findings; they approach teaching and learning via learning goal-orientation and learning success. Quite a number of articles refer to social and cognitive congruence, only two of them use corresponding theoretical approaches [12, 34]. The few references to learning or teaching theory refer to theoretical stress-models [33], experience-based learning theory [7, 36], attribution approach [6], organizational, pedagogical and affective support [7], the feedback model of Van de Ridder [27] and, finally, Vygotsky’s zone of proximal development [28, 32]. Generally, the role of theory is rather weak, and the foundation of the studies in (learning) theories or theoretical models is limited.
cells.note: This is a descriptive synthesis of theoretical approaches, not an effectiveness comparison; the text does not provide a quantified outcome or a direction relative to a defined comparator.

O.outcome_detail: distribution of included studies by teaching arrangement

cells.quote: The majority of studies focusses cross-year-teaching [6, 11, 23, 27–31, 33, 36], while none of the studies explicitly focusses on same-year-teaching.
cells.note: The study reports a descriptive imbalance in the review sample, not a comparative learning outcome or effectiveness result.

D.treatment: P2P-teacher qualification integrating medical content and teaching skills

O.outcome_detail: Competency content identified in qualification measures

cells.quote: the studies show that the practices of qualifying P2P-teachers, either explicitly or implicitly integrate medical skills with teaching skills.
cells.note: Systematic mapping review finding; no comparative treatment, control condition, or effect estimate was reported.

O.outcome_detail: Overlap between the P2P-teacher competency profile and existing medical teaching frameworks

cells.quote: The competency-profile shows overlaps with relevant medical teaching frameworks.
cells.note: The systematic mapping review qualitatively synthesized competency content from 18 studies; it did not test whether the profile improved learning or teaching performance. The supplied study text does not include the detailed CanMEDS/NKLM comparison quoted in the wiki entry.
